chunks: I asked Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
about the word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'and for every people is a guide' [13:7]
So he said: 'Every Imam is a guide for the generation he is among.'

key_terms.إِمَام: Imam — the divinely appointed leader and spiritual guide in Shia theology
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic — an honorific for Allah
key_terms.قَرْن: Generation/era — the people of a particular time period whom the Imam guides
key_terms.هَادٍ: Guide (hadi) — the one who leads and directs people to the straight path; here referring to the Imam

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'and for every people is a guide' (13:7) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the Quranic verse (13:7) 'and for every people is a guide.' The Imam interpreted this verse as referring to the Imams, explaining that each Imam serves as the divinely appointed guide for the people of his era. This hadith is foundational for the Shia doctrine of Imamate, establishing that the Quran's mention of a guide (hadi) in every age refers specifically to the infallible Imams from the Ahlulbayt.
